nodes.title: FACE + BODY: one source performer, two reference photos
STATUS: open /_swap/chain on this same service
Reference roles and first test
widgets_values: Upload the full source video and TWO separate photos into /workspace/input. Refresh the file lists. Picture 1 is the FACE close-up; Picture 2 is the BODY and COMPLETE OUTFIT. Do NOT combine them into a sheet for this workflow. Use workflow 04 for optional two-image long analysis, then paste its CHAIN-SAFE PROMPT into additional_instructions. Use the SAME target_person wording. Leaving that field blank uses the built-in deliberate role prompt. Check a full-person edit mask first. Queue ONCE, review each candidate at /_swap/chain. Both references are passed to every short job. This is prompt-directed, not hard face/body control. Use a NEW run name to change references/settings. Existing single-ref runs remain single-ref. The first test is 10 seconds; set 48 only after a good face/body and join review.
